# Security policy / 安全报告

## Reporting vulnerabilities / 报告漏洞

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting when the repository's Security Advisories page offers **Report a vulnerability**. Include affected module versions or commit SHAs, reproduction steps, impact, and a minimal proof of concept. Redact credentials and personal data.

仓库 Security Advisories 页面提供 **Report a vulnerability** 按钮时，请使用该入口私下报告。请提供受影响模块版本或提交 SHA、复现步骤、影响范围和最小验证示例，并对凭证和个人信息脱敏。

[Security Advisories / 安全公告与报告入口](https://github.com/Zany2/dtoken-go/security/advisories)

If private reporting is unavailable, open an issue titled “Request a private security reporting channel” and include only the request for a private channel. Keep vulnerability details and proof-of-concept code for the private conversation once maintainers provide a channel.

如果私密报告入口尚未启用，请创建标题为“请求私密安全报告渠道”的 Issue，仅提出联系请求。维护者提供私密渠道后，再提交漏洞细节和验证代码。

## Version information / 版本信息

Each module is versioned separately. Include exact affected module versions and, when possible, confirm whether the issue reproduces on the latest release or current development branch. Maintainers will assess the affected versions and remediation scope during triage.

各模块独立管理版本。请填写受影响模块的准确版本，并尽可能确认最新发布版本或当前开发分支是否存在相同问题。维护者将在排查时确认受影响版本和修复范围。
